text:
Aditi: Quick preflight for Mariner on-prem activation tomorrow 09:00 PT. Short check: networking, certs, images, telemetry. I'll list known items and owners.

Aditi: Blocker 1) air-gap image signing — registry artifacts need gpg sigs and our onprem bootstrap fails on unsigned images. Owner: Carla. Current status: signing keys rotated last week; staging artifacts signed, prod not yet. Need confirmation by EOD.

Ben: I can cut a prod signing job, but need the key access. @Carla do you have KMS/HSM access? :eyes: 

Carla: I have read-only KMS perms today. Request submitted for signer role — awaiting approval from people-ops. ETA 6 hours.

Nate: Network note: telemetry egress to telemetry.redwood-infra.com is blocked by customer firewall. We have a fallback to s3-bucket upload but need NAT IPs. @eng-infra who can provide static outbound IPs?

deploy-scheduler: Preflight job mariner-preflight started (job id: m-pr-112). See /deploys/m-pr-112

Ben: For NAT IPs, we can add the static egress from edge-nat-3 (IP 34.204.12.98). Customer needs to whitelist. I can open the CR if we have owner.

Carla: I'll coordinate with customer network ops. Can someone confirm formal IP list and ports: TCP 443, 5678 (metrics), 22 (jumpbox)?

Aditi: Confirm ports: 443 for control plane, 443/5678 for telemetry, 22 for jumpbox only during cutover window (ssh bastion). Avoid wider access.

Nate: Also need to validate cert rotation: onprem nodes currently trust CA v1. Fingerprint: SHA256: abc123... Can we run this to verify quickly?

Ben: Quick check command: 
```
openssl s_client -connect CONTROL_PLANE:443 -showcerts | openssl x509 -noout -fingerprint -sha256
```
Replace CONTROL_PLANE with the VIP.

Carla: I ran it against staging VIP and got SHA256: ABCD... matches. Prod not checked.

Aditi: Prod check would be great. @Carla can you share result before EOD? If not, we gate. :lock:

Carla: I'm looping in customer NOC. If they can't provision signer role, we'll fallback to manual image push signed with temp key — will add to runbook.

Nate: One more dependency: our onprem agent needs access to internal time NTP pool; customer has disabled NTP. We need either allow NTP or install chronyd with rtc sync. Owner: Nate.

Nate: Action: I'll add chrony step to bootstrap script and test in staging. ETA 4 hours.

Aditi: Thanks — updated owners: Carla (image signing + cert check), Ben (egress NAT/IP + CR), Nate (NTP/chrony + firewall validation). If any blocker remains after 18:00 PT we postpone.

Ben: I'll draft CR and ping @eng-infra for approval. :+1:

deploy-scheduler: preflight job m-pr-112 completed: status PARTIAL — waiting on manual sign-off (artifact signing)

Carla: FYI customer NOC responded, they can whitelist 34.204.12.98 and 35.243.77.12. They want an IP list in CSV. I'll send.

Aditi: Great. Final ask: paste the signed artifact checksum and cert fingerprint in this thread when done. short updates only. :eyes:

Ben: checksum: sha256: d4f5e6... (signed artifact) — pushing CR now.

Carla: prod cert fingerprint: SHA256: 9F:8B:... — Verified. Sending CSV now.

Nate: chrony test passed in staging, no drift >2s after 30m.

Aditi: All good, thanks team. We'll proceed with the 09:00 PT cutover as planned. :shipit:

Paul: quick FYI — I'll monitor logs during cutover, ping if things spike.

Aditi: perfect, thanks Paul. Closing thread after cutover summary
